use_constraints: The dataset contains intelligence observations; assignment of independent prohibition intents, owners, scope, validity/actionability and snapshots is done in separate experiment fixtures.
MISP to_ids flags are source-provided for CIRCL and URLhaus; to_ids=true was assigned during the local ThreatFox import. Neither to_ids nor confidence alone authorizes a blocking rule.
Do not infer TCP/UDP for the ThreatFox ip:port or treat the URLhaus contextual IP as a standalone actionable IOC.
Use a controlled isolated test network. Do not generate traffic to live reported malicious public hosts or URLs during validation.
For lab enforcement tests, preserve original CTI source provenance while mapping needed endpoints/traffic to isolated fixtures; document the mapping.
These are source-derived candidate values, not fabricated identical IoCs from multiple independently published CTI reports.
No synthetic first_seen, last_seen, expiration, or natural actionability history has been added.
